description: Society bundle, society.income provider: World Bank PIP country and regional estimates, Eurostat EU-SILC income, poverty and inequality datasets and the OECD Income Distribution Database, for one bounded selection (Germany and the Europe and Central Asia aggregate). Values are quoted as each source released them with definitions, release vintages and flags; no nowcasting, no filled years, no own poverty lines, no blending or re-harmonisation. Audit: docs/development/income-distribution-evidence/source-audit.md.

defaults.temporal_semantics: the source's release clock (PIP release_version date, Eurostat LAST UPDATE, a declared OECD release date, else the retrieval time, labelled) dates each vintage; the reference year is the period; survey year and income reference year are kept per value; vintages appended, never overwritten
defaults.update_cadence: PIP: two to three releases a year; EU-SILC: continuous dataset updates; OECD IDD: about twice a year

policy.personal_data: never; aggregate statistics only, microdata excluded
policy.values: as published per source and release; never blended, filled, nowcast or re-harmonised
policy.poverty_lines: only the lines a source publishes
